frame: one cyclist on a plain road seen from the side, whole figure and bicycle, same size and place on the page, one bare tree beside the road and a plain horizon line, no wind lines. Only the slope of the road and the cyclist's effort change.
sentence_nl: Eerst is de weg vlak, daarna wordt hij steil.
sentence_en: At first the road is flat, then it gets steep.

frame: one thick tree trunk lying on its side on a flat ground line, seen from the cut end at a slight angle so both the bark and the cut face show, a small stone beside it for scale, same size and place on the page. Only the inside of the trunk changes.
sentence_nl: Deze boomstam is massief, maar die boomstam is hol.
sentence_en: This tree trunk is solid, but that tree trunk is hollow.

frame: one plain plate on a plain table, seen from the front at a slight angle from above, same size and place on the page, a butter knife lying beside the plate. On the plate lies the same amount of butter. Only the state of the butter changes.
sentence_nl: Deze boter is vast, maar die boter is vloeibaar.
sentence_en: This butter is solid, but that butter is liquid.

frame: one plain open jar without a lid standing on a plain table, seen from the front, same shape, size and place on the page, plain wall with one straight skirting line behind. The jar holds ten marbles. Only the material of the jar body changes.
sentence_nl: Deze pot is doorzichtig, maar die pot is ondoorzichtig.
sentence_en: This jar is see-through, but that jar is opaque.

frame: one plain kitchen wall seen straight from the front, a small sink at the bottom left, same size and viewpoint on the page, one long straight pipe fixed to the wall with three clips. Only the direction of the pipe changes.
sentence_nl: Deze buis is horizontaal, maar die buis is verticaal.
sentence_en: This pipe is horizontal, but that pipe is vertical.

frame: one donkey and one man on a plain dirt path, seen from the side, whole figures, same size and place on the page, the man in front holding a rope tied to the donkey's halter, a low fence behind. Only the donkey's posture and the rope change.
sentence_nl: Gisteren was de ezel koppig, maar vandaag is hij gehoorzaam.
sentence_en: Yesterday the donkey was stubborn, but today it is obedient.

frame: two children standing side by side on a plain floor line, seen from the front, whole figures, same size and place on the page, the boy on the left holding a full bag of sweets, the girl on the right with empty hands. Only what the boy does with the bag changes.
sentence_nl: Vroeger was de jongen gierig, maar nu is hij vrijgevig.
sentence_en: The boy used to be stingy, but now he is generous.

frame: one long-sleeved shirt hanging on a plain coat hanger from a hook on a plain wall, seen from the front, whole shirt, same size and place on the page. Only the surface of the shirt changes.
sentence_nl: Dit overhemd is gekreukt, maar dat overhemd is gestreken.
sentence_en: This shirt is creased, but that shirt is ironed.

frame: one small round pond in a plain park, seen from the side at a slight angle, one bare tree and one bench beside it, one duck on the pond, same size and place on the page. Only the surface of the pond and how the duck is on it change.
sentence_nl: Gisteren was de vijver bevroren, maar vandaag is hij ontdooid.
sentence_en: Yesterday the pond was frozen, but today it has thawed.

frame: one plain round bowl of lettuce leaves on a plain table, seen from the front, same size and place on the page, a small fork resting beside the bowl. Only the shape of the leaves changes.
sentence_nl: Deze sla is knapperig, maar die sla is slap.
sentence_en: This lettuce is crisp, but that lettuce is limp.

frame: one small field seen from the side at a slight angle, a plain horizon line behind it, a low fence along the front, a farmer standing at the fence, same size and place on the page. Only the ground and what grows in it change.
sentence_nl: Deze grond is vruchtbaar, maar die grond is dor.
sentence_en: This soil is fertile, but that soil is barren.

frame: one football on a plain flat ground line, seen from the side, same size and place on the page, a small hand pump lying beside it, plain background, no writing on the ball. Only the amount of air in the ball changes.
sentence_nl: Gisteren was de bal leeggelopen, maar nu is hij opgepompt.
sentence_en: Yesterday the ball had gone flat, but now it is pumped up.

frame: one apple on a small plain plate on a plain table, seen from the front, same size and place on the page, a small knife lying beside the plate. Only the skin of the apple changes.
sentence_nl: Deze appel is geschild, maar die appel is ongeschild.
sentence_en: This apple is peeled, but that apple is unpeeled.

frame: one rug on a plain wooden floor in an empty room, seen from the front at a slight angle from above, same size and place on the page, a plain wall behind. Only whether the rug lies rolled or flat changes.
sentence_nl: Eerst is het tapijt opgerold, daarna ligt het uitgerold op de vloer.
sentence_en: First the rug is rolled up, then it lies rolled out on the floor.

frame: one horse standing in a plain field behind a low wooden fence, seen from the side, whole animal, same size and place on the page, one man standing outside the fence holding out an open hand. Only the horse's posture changes.
sentence_nl: Vroeger was het paard agressief, maar nu is het mak.
sentence_en: The horse used to be aggressive, but now it is tame.
